data.title: Investigate claude review failures — failed 2 times

data.reason: claude review agent failed 2 times — investigate

data.body: Orchestrator investigation (run context): the 'claude review agent failed 2x' is the auto-fired code-review on status transitions running from the MAIN checkout against worktree feature branches — it cannot resolve the diff ('Could not resolve diff automatically' / 'Diff is empty'). Root-caused independently by three delegators this run; documented in lessons-learned.md (2026-06-07 entries) with the own-reviewer fallback as the working path. All review gates in this run are satisfied via attached --role review artifacts. Upstream fix belongs in the Lattice repo (code-review worktree↔root bridge, LAT-219 family) — out of scope for the Etch run. Clearing needs_human; cancelling as investigated.
